title: Quietly Roasted Canadian Chicken Roast
description: A roasted, velvety, nostalgic Canadian dish featuring sweet smoked paprika, mushimono-steam, and diabetic-friendly ingredients, all cooked to perfection in a wok. This recipe is a hearty and flavorful meal that is sure to become a favorite.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together the sweet smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper.
Rub the spice mixture all over the chicken breast, making sure to coat it evenly.
Heat the olive oil in a large wok over medium-high heat.
Sear the chicken breast in the wok for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until it is browned.
Add the water to the wok and bring to a boil.
Cover the wok with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Roast the chicken in the oven for 25-30 minutes, or until it is cooked through.
Remove the wok from the oven and let the chicken rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
